$comment: Business model of the 'energy supervision' deployment (spec supervision-energetique-spec-fonctionnelle.md §4.1, RG-1/RG-2). Applied at boot by the fap-ldp node: app.* tables, triggers (updated_at, versioning, tombstone, outbox), FORCE RLS + auth.can() policies, dsp.asset_mapping, initial ACLs. Base: fap-ldp/examples/supervision/model.json + change requests front spec §13.4 (lat/lon WGS84 on buildings) and §13.5 (priority LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL default MEDIUM) + fap-ldp spec v0.4 decision K (business_rules ticket_status_workflow, 409 invalid_transition rejection, CA-L15). Field dialect = model.js node parser: '<type> fk <table>(<col>)', '<type> check in (...)', comment in parentheses at the END of the string (nothing after). RG-1 (a ticket is always attached to a building): building_id as FK, also enforced PEP-side.

components.$comment: Chantier 3 (app-ui-editor, app-store-spec v0.6 §1.4.3) — declarative stage of the app store: published component documents as LDP resources in /components/ (envelope { slug, sri, document }). Read: any authenticated pod user (ACL seed 142); write: admin (publication POST /components/). published=false → served over LDP to pod members, not exposed in the external data space (same regime as /features/). id = internal key for app.versions; the exposed IRI is the slug (/components/<slug>).

fields.id: bigserial (internal key for app.versions/outbox; NOT the exposed key)
fields.slug: text unique not null (exposed IRI key: /components/<slug>)
fields.sri: text not null (sha384 of the canonical document, @id excluded — J8)
fields.document: jsonb not null (the JSON-LD component document; the runtime unwraps `document`)

ai_models.$comment: Chantier 5 (pile IA, spec ch.4/5 annexe B) — local model registry, container /ai_models/, one resource per model. Read: any authenticated user (profiles pick a model); write: admin. NO credential (F1.4): endpoint/model_id only; secrets live in the ORCE service env. `name` is the exact value of cmp:model (e.g. ollama://mistral-small).

fields.id: bigserial (internal key for app.versions/outbox; NOT the exposed key)
fields.name: text unique not null (exposed IRI key: /ai_models/<name>; value of cmp:model)
fields.protocol: text not null default 'openai_chat' check in ('openai_chat')
fields.endpoint: text not null (base URI, no credential)
fields.model_id: text not null (model id on the endpoint side)

business_rules.name: ticket_status_workflow
business_rules.doc: RG-2 + front spec 13.5 + decision K (CA-L15): invalid transition → 409 dspace:Error invalid_transition. 'assigned_to' = user assigned to the ticket.
